# Publishing to the public repositories

**English** · [Português](pt/PUBLISHING.md)

Today the kit points to **https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude** (memory app: **https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/claude-memory-app**). You switch in one file, `repos.conf`, and the rest is generated.

## Checklist (5 steps)

1. **Update `repos.conf`.** Use the script, which edits the file and generates the documentation again:

   ```bash
   tools/switch-repos.sh --workshop-url https://github.com/<owner>/workshop-claude.git \
     --memory-url https://github.com/<owner>/claude-memory-app.git \
     --raw-pattern 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner}/{name}/{version}/{path}' \
     --release-pattern '{repo}/releases/download/{version}/{file}'
   ```

   On Windows: `tools/switch-repos.ps1 -WorkshopUrl … -MemoryUrl …`. To create the releases on GitHub, also set `RELEASE_PROVIDER=github`.

2. **Generate the slides and the documentation again.** `node tools/render.mjs` (the READMEs in every language, `docs/INSTALL.md`, `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`, this file and their versions in `docs/pt/`, `docs/hi/` and `docs/he/`) and the slides build, which reads `repos.conf` directly.

3. **Create the public releases with the same versions.** Kit `v1.0.0-rc.5` and app `v0.5.0`:

   ```bash
   tools/build-release.sh v1.0.0-rc.5
   tools/publish-release.sh v1.0.0-rc.5 --dry-run   # shows what will be uploaded
   tools/publish-release.sh v1.0.0-rc.5
   ```

   The memory app is published from its own repository, with the same version.

4. **Run `--check` against the new URLs**, on a clean machine or with a temporary `HOME`:

   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-rc.5/setup-mac.sh | bash -s -- --check
   ```

   On Windows: `$env:WORKSHOP_SETUP_ARGS='-Check'; irm https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-rc.5/bootstrap-windows.ps1 | iex`.

5. **Look for leftovers of the development server.** `node tools/check-repo.mjs` fails if `gitea.guilhermepinto.pt` appears outside `repos.conf` and the generated files. Also confirm with `git grep -n gitea.guilhermepinto.pt`.

Current values: release at https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/tag/v1.0.0-rc.5, checksums at https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-rc.5/SHA256SUMS.
